Updates on publications, talks, and research software.

## From LinkedIn

Selected recent updates shared on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/giovanni-castellazzi-6870436a/):

- **Q4RS, a quadrilateral Reissner–Mindlin shell element.** This work with Petr Krysl presents a four-node element with six degrees of freedom per node and an open-source Julia implementation. [Read the post](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/giovanni-castellazzi-6870436a_fem-finiteelements-computationalmechanics-activity-7462049754047406080-3iPg).
- **PhD course in Łódź.** Five days of lectures on the computational mechanics of historical masonry at Lodz University of Technology, supported by NAWA. [Read the post](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/giovanni-castellazzi-6870436a_computationalmechanics-historicalmasonry-activity-7466782335401648128-Jdf6).
- **The Strength of the Past.** An introduction to the book co-authored with Alberto Taliercio on the mechanics of historic masonry structures. [Read the post](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/giovanni-castellazzi-6870436a_thestrengthofthepast-students-youngresearchers-activity-7419064919142260736-FD7R).
